questions_before_times: What is the RV doing, and since when? In the customer's own words
Type (motorhome, travel trailer, fifth wheel, camper van), year, make and model
Length and height, and the mileage if it has an engine
Any propane smell, carbon monoxide alarm, burning smell or water near the wiring?
For a mobile job: where it's parked (home, storage lot, campground and site), and whether it has power and water hookups
license: if: where the state registers repair shops or certifies technicians; a propane (LP-gas) certificate where the state requires one; an EPA certificate for refrigerant work
